has_mention.description: Indicates whether the concept was mentioned in the text.
has_mention.title: Has Mention

spans.description: The verbatim text where this concept was mentioned.
spans.title: Spans

event_type.description: Documented event. Use clinician-designated progression or relapse; progression can follow partial response. SECOND_MALIGNANCY does not require proven treatment causation. SECOND_PRIMARY requires explicit designation, not a time/site heuristic. Exclude suspected, negated or family-history events.

source_of_event_diagnosis.description: Evidence actually establishing this event; no arbitrary proximity window or surgery priority.

event_date.description: Earliest date explicitly establishing this event, ISO date at supported precision. Do not replace earlier confirmed progression with a later biopsy date. For death use actual death date, never the note date.
event_date.title: Event Date

event_date_precision.description: Precision for event_date; null if absent.

date_of_progression_mri.description: Explicit progression MRI date, retained separately from clinical confirmation; null for other events.
date_of_progression_mri.title: Date Of Progression Mri

date_of_progression_mri_precision.description: Precision for date_of_progression_mri; null if absent.

confirmation_date.description: Later confirmation date if explicitly distinct from first event evidence.
confirmation_date.title: Confirmation Date

confirmation_date_precision.description: Precision for confirmation_date; null if absent.

events.description: Distinct documented events, including undated events. Deduplication and EFS adjudication occur downstream.
events.title: Events
